mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at clear skies and 57 degrees near Harriet Park. Under this waxing gibbous moon, space fans should look for the International Space Station at 4:57 AM, rising over Mount Horeb in the west and traveling toward Madison near Home Depot, climbing halfway up the sky for a five minute show.

The City of Verona is seeking an Engineering Technician to manage municipal projects, with applications due September 20. Additionally, property owners can take advantage of the rain barrel rebate program, which offers 30 dollars back for qualified installations to help with stormwater management.

There is plenty happening today, including Live Music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus a Girls Try Hockey session at the Verona Ice Arena. Tomorrow, you can head over to Insight Wellness for a yoga session.

Regarding the weekly police report, on Friday, August 15, an officer conducted a traffic stop involving a 44-year-old woman who was found to be operating a vehicle while intoxicated, resulting in an O W I arrest.

Today's flavor is the savory and sweet Caramel Cashew. Culver's is currently closed but will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM. If you are planning for tomorrow, the flavor will be Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
